docs.purpose: The admin media library: every report image and ad creative an admin has uploaded, with a small preview, its kind, scenario key, position, alt text, type, size and upload time, and a button that removes one.
docs.data_story: It reads media_assets through the admin list contract, which returns at most media_list_page_max rows with a short-lived signed preview URL each; a row whose URL could not be signed shows without a preview.
docs.under_126: **GENERATED.** Rendered by the web LIST binding (mantine-datatable) from this descriptor and its content file; no hand-built component.

inputs.why: One QUERY contract returns the rows with server display strings and sort keys; the page reads it on the server first and passes plain data.
evidence: src/lib/media/list.ts — listMedia()

outputs.why: The only write is the delete, through the delete FORM and its MUTATION contract; the list refreshes from the server after it.
evidence: contract_admin_media_delete
outputs.rollback: None is applied locally, so none is undone: the list re-reads after the server answers.

state.why: An RSC page: the rows arrive from the server per request and refresh after a mutation; sort state is a local view choice.
evidence: src/app/(maxbld)/admin/media/page.tsx

staleness.why: Read per request; the browser may keep the GET response for media_list_cache_seconds (private).
evidence: scripts/seeds/logic_variables.json — media_list_cache_seconds

session.why: An /admin/** page: classifyRoute returns "admin" for any pathname starting with /admin/, and "admin" is the profiles.is_admin flag checked in-predicate, not a Postgres role.
evidence: src/lib/auth/route-guard.ts:162 — pathname === "/admin" || pathname.startsWith("/admin/") returns "admin"
src/lib/auth/route-guard.ts:159 — /api/admin/ returns "admin" for the contract half
migrations/226_profiles_admin_bootstrap.sql:27 — is_admin BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false
docs/specs/00-architecture/114_rls_policy_catalog.md §2 — there is no admin Postgres role; admin is a column flag checked inside the policy predicate

rls_class.why: media_assets is Class B by Spec 114 §2's definitional rule and carries the ONE ruled admin-read pattern (Wave 1 decision batch item 1): RLS on, one media_assets_select_admin policy (profiles.is_admin), no write policy; the routes read and write through the owner connection, so the policy is defence in depth.
evidence: docs/specs/00-architecture/114_rls_policy_catalog.md §2 dated note 2026-11-09 — the one ruled admin-read pattern (media_assets, offers, advertisers)
migrations/300_media_assets_surface_media.sql — media_assets, RLS on, media_assets_select_admin, the surface-media bucket and three admin policies

checks.why: R-12: each upload and each delete writes exactly one admin_audit_log row in the same transaction as the row change; an audit failure fails the request.
The LIST profile requires a deliberate empty state from content, never the library default text.

errors.why: Every admin route handler is wrapped by withApiEnvelope, which returns { data, error, meta } with a sanitised code on any throw; the surface renders from that envelope rather than from a raw exception.
evidence: src/lib/api/with-api-envelope.ts:27 — withApiEnvelope always returns the { data, error, meta } envelope
src/lib/api/with-api-envelope.ts:40-45 — a PG SQLSTATE becomes DATABASE_ERROR; the raw message is never exposed

classes.ui: Redirect to sign-in — the route guard refuses before the page renders.
Full-page "admin only" block naming the is_admin requirement; no partial data.
Full-width error panel carrying the envelope error.code, with a retry control.
The row that failed to parse renders as a red schema_drift row; the rest of the table still renders.

emits.why: Uploads and deletes write admin_audit_log rows (action media_upload / media_delete); the list itself writes nothing.
evidence: src/lib/admin/admin-audit.ts — writeAdminAudit
breadcrumbs: admin_audit_log: action media_upload | media_delete, target_uid = asset_id

offers.why: It manages the image files a SLOT or the report renders; it renders no sponsored placement itself.

metering.why: An operator act, not a metered product action; the admin preview ledger is deferred (Spec 114 §6 dated note 2026-11-09).
evidence: docs/specs/02-web-admin/126_maxbld_surface_standard.md §6.5 dated note 2026-11-09 — the surface-media bucket, admin scope, signed URLs

logic_variables.why: The ruled cap (3 MB or less, batch item 2); a wrong value lets an oversize file through or refuses every file.

logic_variables.why: The list cap; above it the list shows its partial state.

sharing.why: media_assets is read by this library and, later, by the report images (MF-38) and ad creatives (MF-40).
evidence: docs/specs/02-web-admin/126_maxbld_surface_standard.md §6.5 dated note 2026-11-09 — the surface-media bucket, admin scope, signed URLs
sharing.varies_by_surface: The admin list shows every row with a short-lived preview URL; the report reads one ordered list per scenario key and rule set.

limitations.what: The admin_audit_log row this surface writes cannot be named in emits.ledger_events[].
limitations.measured: surface.schema.json's emits.ledger_events[] is closed to usage_events events; admin_audit_log is the second append-only ledger with no token, so emits.answer is "ledger" and the audit row is carried in breadcrumbs[] plus a ledger_row_present check (the admin_placements precedent).

notes: MF-37. Pagination is none: the list is capped at media_list_page_max and shows the partial state above it (cursor pagination deferred).

programme.why: The admin media library (MF-37): the report images and ad creatives the parcel product renders, uploaded and deleted by an admin.
